literal_meaning: একটু অংশ এবং আধটু অংশ (কিছু অল্প পরিমাণ এবং অসম্পূর্ণ অংশ)
figurative_meaning_en: a little here and there; approximately; somewhat; vaguely; in small quantities
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বিষয়ে আমার একটু-আধটু জানা আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I have a little knowledge about this topic.
He can speak a little bit of Bengali.
note: This idiom is widely used in spoken Bengali to indicate partial or superficial knowledge or quantity.
